messages:
Maya: heads up — nightly model-refresh (cron @ 03:00) failed for shard upload. checksum mismatch on shard s-0007.
Liam: :eyes: saw similar once, usually multipart upload ordering. Can you paste the error lines?
Maya: ```
ERROR model-sync: shard s-0007 checksum mismatch (expected=3f5a... got=7a9b...)
Trace: model_sync/uploader.go:214
S3ETag: "d41d8cd98f00b204e9800998ecf8427e-3"
``` 
Sara: hmm ETag with -3 indicates multipart. Could be parts retried and concatenated wrong. Did the uploader change recently?
Maya: last deploy was yesterday, PR #4823 touched model-sync uploader retry logic.
Liam: that's the suspect. Can we rerun the cron once without concurrent uploads?
Maya: scheduling rerun now: /rerun cron model-refresh --no-concurrent
deploy-bot: Scheduled rerun for job model-refresh at 2026-03-18T03:12:00Z
Maya: rerun finished — still failing same checksum :(
Liam: can you capture the S3 object manifest and part sizes? `aws s3api list-parts --bucket acme-models-staging --key models/resnet18/s-0007`
Maya: pasted output in thread, but quick snapshot: parts sizes [5242880, 5242880, 4120000]
Jen: looping in @jen — I'm taking this. I'll rollback uploader change and re-run a single shard upload test.
Jen: rolling back PR #4823 to the deploy-preview branch, running unit/integ shard-upload test now.
Jen: tests passed locally. Will attempt a controlled upload to staging bucket.
Maya: thanks — if rollback fixes it, we should bisect to find which retry path caused ordering.
Liam: agree — if we confirm, open a bisect ticket and tag eng-ml + eng-runtime. Also add an E2E that verifies S3 ETag on multipart uploads.
Jen: noted. I'll update team channels once I've validated. :thumbsup:
